name: @telorun/vector-store-pgvector-build
description: Build-only package for the std/vector-store-pgvector module's bundled controller. Never published — the controller ships inside the module artifact as a pkg:telo/local/js bundle. This package exists to declare the dependencies esbuild inlines and to TYPE-CHECK the source, which esbuild does not do.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && esbuild src/store.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=node20 --external:@telorun/sdk --conditions=source --outdir=. --banner:js='import { createRequire as __teloCreateRequire } from "node:module";const require = __teloCreateRequire(import.meta.url);' --out-extension:.js=.mjs
